message.content: I checked the broker's market summary for AAPL, which showed the stock trading near $222.70 in a quiet session (volume ~41.2M) with no corporate actions pending, and confirmed with a live quote of $222.70 last ($222.68 bid / $222.72 ask, as of 15:05Z on 2024-11-06). Because the stock was liquid, stable, and inside my AAPL/MSFT-only, buy-only mandate, and because the account held $50,000 in cash (well above the $20,000 daily cap) with no conflicting position, I placed a single buy order for 44 shares at a limit of $222.75 — one cent above the ask, so still essentially at market — which filled at $222.75 for a total of about $9,801, comfortably under both the $10,000 per-order limit and the $20,000 daily limit, with no money leaving the account. The key reported figures I relied on from AAPL's FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) were revenue of $391,035 million, net income of $93,736 million, and diluted EPS of $6.08, which support the view of a fundamentally sound, profitable issuer for a modest, mandate-compliant position.
